unit_portion:
A control that was supposed to re-derive an earlier selection of sixteen items could not be run at all: the sixteen were recorded only as a count, and the list of which items they were was never written down. Re-running the same selection procedure over the same unchanged data now yields two hundred and ninety-three, out of a base that has itself moved from ninety-eight to nine hundred and forty-four. Nothing in either number says why.

The earlier result was a selection computed by the classifying machinery, and what was preserved from it was the size of the selection plus five member names quoted in passing. The machinery kept changing over the following four weeks. Because a count carries no record of the rules that produced it, the new count and the old count are not comparable and the difference cannot be attributed: from the two numbers alone, a selection growing from sixteen to two hundred and ninety-three is equally consistent with more data having arrived and with the selection rules having loosened, and here it is the second — the underlying data set is the same archived one throughout. A count over machine-computed selections is relative to the machine's state at the time, and the state was not recorded alongside it. What survived the drift is exactly the part that was written as identities rather than as a total: all five recorded names still select, and their individual computed values match to the digit. The lesson is stated in the close: save member lists, not population counts.

An attempt to run a pre-planned control. The plan required the new selection to recover the earlier thirteen strict and three loose members; the attempt failed at the first step, because there was nothing to recover against. The audit then re-derived the selection on the same archived data at the current machine state, cross-witnessed the new base figure against an independent acceptance check recorded elsewhere at the same state, and compared against the current working data set as a third point — which is what established that the movement is in the machinery and not in the data. The control was recorded as retired-as-impossible rather than as passed, and the resulting ranking was relabelled as a current-state selection anchored by three named members rather than as a recovery of the earlier sixteen.

One planned control cannot be run, now or ever, for this result. The earlier finding survives only as the handful of members someone happened to name in prose, and any later reader comparing the two population figures without the machine state would read a nineteen-fold difference as a change in the data. The same exposure applies to every other result in the record that was preserved as a count over a computed selection.
payload:
You will read one description of a software failure and assign it exactly one category.

Here are the five categories, plus a sixth for incidents that fit none of them. All six are equally
available answers. Each category is given in its original wording followed by an English rendering.

A — 环境/平台 Quirk  (environment / platform quirk)
逻辑正确，运行环境隐含行为导致失效（dev 绿灯，target 暴露）。
系统逻辑正确，但运行环境（OS / shell / 客户端 / 文件系统）的隐含行为导致意外。
*The logic is correct, but implicit behaviour of the runtime environment — operating system, shell,
client, filesystem — causes it to fail. Characteristically: the development environment is always
green, and only running on the real target exposes it.*

B — 设计假设错配  (design-assumption mismatch)
代码假设 vs 实际（部署拓扑 / 契约 / 测试形态 / 涌现行为）。
代码基于某个假设，但假设与实际不一致。
*The code rests on an assumption — about deployment topology, a cross-component contract, the shape
of test input, or emergent behaviour — and the assumption does not match reality. Characteristically:
unit tests covering the logic correctly is not the same as covering the real caller's actual form.*

C — 错误吞噬与稀释  (error swallowing and dilution)
错误发生但被某层静默吃掉 / 跨层稀释失 cause / 自动批量放大。
错误真实发生了，但被某一层静默吃掉，或跨层传递时上游 cause 被稀释，最终用户视角看到的是"成功"或
一个失去信息的告警。
*The error really happened, but some layer silently ate it, or the upstream cause was diluted while
being passed across layers, so what the end user finally sees is "success" or an alert that has lost
its information.*

D — 链式幻觉与编造  (chained hallucination and fabrication)
把污染数据当事实，编造合理叙事推送给用户（最危险）。
错误不是消失，而是被加工成看起来正常的内容。链路中每一跳都会放大幻觉，前一跳的幻觉会被下游当作
事实执行。
*Corrupted data or polluted context is taken as fact and worked up into a plausible narrative that
is pushed to the user. The error does not disappear — it is processed into content that looks
normal. Each hop amplifies it, and one hop's fabrication is executed downstream as fact.*

E — 运维遗漏与取证盲区  (operational omission and forensic blind spot)
代码正确但部署/注册步骤遗漏 / 调试工具自身被屏蔽长潜伏。
两个子机制：(1) 运维遗漏 — 代码正确但部署/注册/配置步骤被漏（声明态 ≠ 运行时态）；
(2) 取证盲区 — 调试工具自身被屏蔽返回空内容，被误读为"正常"，导致超长潜伏。
*Two sub-mechanisms: (1) operational omission — the code is correct but a deployment, registration
or configuration step was missed, so declared state is not runtime state; (2) forensic blind spot —
the debugging tool is itself blocked and returns empty content, which is misread as "normal",
producing an extremely long latency before discovery.*

other — 机制不属于以上任何一类。
*The incident's mechanism is not one of the five above. This is a substantive answer, not a
leftover. Choose it whenever the mechanism described is genuinely a different kind of thing,
including when the description is too thin to identify a mechanism at all.*
